## Customer Due Diligence (CDD)  
See [[policy_customer_identification]] for Identity and Address Verification.  
**AML-Specific CDD Elements:**
name: Chunk 9/35

raw_entities.name: Customer Due Diligence Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing Customer Due Diligence (CDD) requirements, including identity and address verification procedures and AML-specific due diligence elements. The policy establishes the bank's framework for verifying customer information and assessing risk in accordance with anti-money laundering obligations.
context: See [[policy_customer_identification]] for Identity and Address Verification

raw_entities.name: Customer Identification Policy
raw_entities.description: A referenced policy document that governs Identity and Address Verification procedures for customers. This policy is cross-referenced as the authoritative source for customer identification requirements within the CDD framework.
context: See [[policy_customer_identification]] for Identity and Address Verification

raw_entities.name: Identity and Address Verification
raw_entities.description: The process of verifying customer identity and address information as part of Customer Due Diligence obligations. This verification is governed by the Customer Identification Policy and forms a core component of the bank's KYC framework.
context: See [[policy_customer_identification]] for Identity and Address Verification

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering
raw_entities.description: The risk of customer accounts and transactions being used to conceal the origins of illegally obtained funds. AML-specific CDD elements are implemented to detect and prevent money laundering activities.
